name: Bureaucrat Male

traits.face_shape: Long, angular rectangular male face with a broad lower third
traits.hair_length_base: Very short, closely cropped sides and back, with a slightly longer top
traits.body_build: Tall, lean male build with firm musculature, not bulky
traits.body_proportions: Broad upper torso tapering to a straight, narrow pelvis; shoulders clearly wider than hips
traits.waist_definition: Straight, lightly tapered male waist without a sharply pinched midsection
traits.hip_width: Narrow hips aligned with a straight trouser silhouette
traits.chest_shape: Broad, flat masculine chest with subtle pectoral definition
traits.neck_length: Long, substantial neck with defined tendons
traits.jawline: Broad, sharply defined lower jaw with pronounced square jaw angles
traits.eye_shape: Deep-set eyes with a stern, composed gaze
traits.nose_shape: Straight, well-defined bridge with a moderately broad base
traits.facial_hair: Clean-shaven, with a clearly defined jaw and chin
traits.hairstyle: Closely cropped sides and back with a short, smooth top swept straight backward; compact, squared silhouette around the temples
traits.facial_markings: Thin angular blue-gray markings extend from the outer eye across the cheek toward the ear

description:
top: High black turtleneck fitted smoothly over a broad, flat chest.
outerwear: Long asymmetrical charcoal-gray government-official's coat with broad overlapping lapels and squared, structured shoulders. Masculine formal tailoring follows a straight, lightly tapered torso; the lower coat has separated straight panels and a clear central opening over trousers.
asymmetric sleeves: The right arm has a dark-gray sleeve with a broad black cuff. The left arm has a fitted blue segmented sleeve with angular seams and a short blue shoulder covering trimmed in pale gold.
wrist detail: A restrained rigid pale-gold bracelet cuff on the left wrist, matching the blue segmented sleeve.
chest detail: Small rectangular pale-gold official insignia.
belt: Narrow formal black belt with a square gold clasp at the natural waist, fastening the coat without a tightly cinched silhouette.
coat panels: Long dark-charcoal asymmetric panels with gray borders, extending toward the ankles; vivid orange inner lining and a slim orange inset are visible through the coat opening and side vent.
trousers: Straight-cut charcoal tailored trousers with a distinct two-leg silhouette, visible below and between the coat panels.
footwear: Dark blue-gray square-toed formal men's loafers with flat, low-profile soles, worn with plain black socks.
earring: One small geometric pale-gold stud earring.
constraints: Preserve the charcoal-gray, black, blue, vivid orange and pale-gold palette. Keep the asymmetrical official-uniform design, squared shoulders, straight masculine tailoring and clearly separate trouser legs. The orange fabric is the coat lining and inset; the lower-body garment is a pair of tailored trousers.

description:

hosiery: Black stockings

name: Inventor

traits.body_proportions: LEFT arm amputated above the elbow. A permanent red-and-black mechanical prosthetic forearm attaches to the upper-arm stump and ends in an EMPTY exposed circular docking socket, with NO mechanical hand, fingers or claw. The RIGHT hand is intact
traits.skin_texture: Weathered skin with deep forehead wrinkles
traits.left_arm_prosthesis: Permanent red-and-black mechanical prosthetic forearm attached to the LEFT upper-arm stump: angular crimson plates, silver brackets, exposed mechanisms, and two small cyan-tipped cylinders
traits.prosthesis_terminal: EMPTY exposed circular docking socket at the far end of the LEFT prosthesis, with a silver rim and dark internal connectors. NO mechanical hand, fingers or claw is attached

description:
outerwear: Charcoal-gray utility jacket with black reinforced shoulders, a standing collar, two dark-brown rectangular chest pockets, a red central zipper, and rolled sleeves with thick cream cuffs
top: Dark ribbed turtleneck beneath the jacket
trousers: Dark tactical trousers with orange-trimmed knee pads
footwear: Heavy black combat boots
right hand tool: The intact RIGHT hand holds an ENTIRELY SEPARATE, detachable forearm-length tool, NOT just a claw: an elongated red mechanical forearm section, proximal coupling connector, black hinges, cyan accents, and THREE broad flat angular hooked prongs at the far end
tool separation: Keep the detachable tool in the RIGHT hand separate from the permanent LEFT prosthesis; the LEFT docking socket remains empty

name: Rebel

traits.facial_hair: Neatly kept short dark beard and mustache
traits.overall_character: Youthful, rebellious, energetic, practical and confrontational

description:
goggles: Red-orange round-lensed goggles worn around the neck, resting against the cobalt-blue shirt
shirt: Cobalt-blue shirt
outerwear: Oversized olive-green military-style trench coat worn open and extending below the knees; tall open collar, broad shoulders, large chest pockets, softly rumpled sleeves, dark cuffs, and wide off-white reflective stripes near the lower hem
chest harness: Black tactical chest harness with a prominent rectangular orange panel and a large black utility pouch with small red accents
trousers: Baggy dark burgundy cargo trousers with an orange hanging utility strap, a narrow red vertical stripe, and oversized red block lettering running down one leg
glove: One hand wears a black fingerless tactical glove
footwear: Heavy dark brown combat boots with thick soles, reinforced toes and wide ankle straps

name: Cheater

traits.hair_color: Black with vivid deep-red streaks on one side

description:
headwear: Black baseball cap with a curved brim and two small vertical gray markings on the front
earrings: Small silver dangling earrings
neck jewelry: Layered black chokers and a delicate necklace with a metallic pendant
outerwear: Oversized slate-gray bomber jacket worn open, with broad sleeves, dark shoulder panels, a large hood with crimson-red lining, bright orange interior accents and multiple gold zippers
top: Fitted black cropped top with asymmetric straps and a decorative band beneath the bust, exposing the toned abdomen and navel
trousers: Loose charcoal-black cargo pants worn low on the hips, with large thigh pockets, a horizontal gold zipper, layered fabric panels and gathered ankles
belt: Wide black belt with a rectangular buckle
footwear: Black ankle-high boots with prominent burgundy-red vertical accents and thick light-gray soles

name: Protector

traits.skin_tone: Tan skin on the exposed lower face

description:
face visibility: Only the lower face is exposed; the eyes are completely concealed by a solid dark faceplate
helmet: Oversized angular black helmet with a projecting upper brow, solid dark faceplate, narrow red visor markings, triangular red vents, and distinctive red-and-white accents along the upper edges
body armor: Bulky futuristic tactical armor in layered charcoal, midnight blue and muted purple; massive angular shoulder plates, reinforced neck guard, overlapping chest plates, rectangular chest compartments, dark straps, and a wide diagonal black harness
sleeves: Thick gray sleeves with armored elbows
gloves: Heavy dark-gray tactical gloves
belt and hip guards: Broad utility belt with attached pouches and rigid hip guards
trousers: Baggy gray combat trousers with reinforced thighs, segmented knee protection, dark straps and armored shin panels
footwear: Heavy black tactical boots
armor accents: Bright red-orange accents along the helmet, shoulders, elbows and hips
baton: Long black baton
riot shield: Large transparent riot shield with a thick silver-metal frame, blue-gray transparent panels, angular internal supports, and a prominent horizontal black rectangle bordered in vivid red

name: Gambler

traits.hair_color: Pale warm golden champagne blonde; softly yellow-gold, not silver, gray or white
traits.hairstyle: Silky perfectly straight long hair, flat off-center part, falling beside the face to the upper chest; no swept-back silver crest

description:
earrings: Huge oversized geometric rectangular yellow-gold architectural earrings
neck jewelry: Rigid segmented gold choker
outerwear: Extravagant coat with an enormous stiff upright charcoal-purple collar rising beside the head; exceptionally broad red-orange shoulder panels edged in dark navy; voluminous deep burgundy sleeves with wide cuffs. Dark navy lapels converge at a small tilted two-piece gold clasp
top: Fitted silver-gray bodice beneath the coat
lower garment: Floor-length, strongly asymmetric: a vivid orange-red panel on her RIGHT (viewer's LEFT), partly covered at the hip by pale gray fabric; a wider flared silver-gray panel on her LEFT (viewer's RIGHT)
hand jewelry: Several large angular geometric gold rings and chunky rigid gold bracelet cuffs
footwear: Black shoes with bright gold trim
signature detail: The gold earrings, choker, rings and bracelet cuffs are key features: large, prominent, sharp and clearly visible, in bright true-metal gold with crisp reflections and fine detail
